A '''[[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Ho'Din was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Having constructed his own green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], he studied as a [[Jedi Consular|Consular]], specializing in the art of [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] and becoming one of the Order's [[Jedi healer/Legends|healers]]. The Ho'Din selected a [[Unidentified Human Padawan|young]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="SWDT7" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Master took up the mantle of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the ranks of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Along with his Padawan, the Master was assigned to assist in the evacuation of the planet [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]] following an [[Battle of Nadiem|invasion]] by the Confederacy. While ushering citizens to the rescue shuttles, he came a cross a [[Crys Taanzer|young mother]] and her wounded [[Kennan Taanzer|child]]. Taking a moment to heal the boy's wounds, the Ho'Din Master marveled at the boy's sense of calm amidst all the turmoil. Suspicious of the boy's Force-sensitivity, the Ho'Din summoned his Padawan to take a blood sample of the boy, which came up positive for sensitivity.<ref name="SWDT7" />

Because there were limited shuttles off the planet, and the Order was in desperate need of new recruits, the Master offered to designate the boy for priority evacuation, if his mother agreed to give him over to the Order for training. Assuring the young woman that her son would reach safety at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] within two days, she agreed, and her son was taken off world. Not long afterwards, the Ho'Din was forced into battle with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] to defend the refugees. Surrounded by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the Jedi was quickly overwhelmed by the superior number of droids.<ref name="SWDT7" />
